About a quarter of the students at UWC are in university
residences. The Residential and Catering Services Offi ce allocates
and manages accommodation in university residences for about
5800 full-time UWC students. Applicants for places (or for
readmission to residence at the beginning of a new year) must be
in good academic and fi nancial standing and have a clean
disciplinary record. Details of what these requirements mean are
available on request.
